title: Termination Condition as Argument in Team Constructor instead of Team Run
body:
### What happened?

Currently we have termination condition specified in a team `run` method. 
This makes running tasks heavier than it ought to be as the developer needs to pass a termination condition each time the team is run.
Also, in most use cases, this condition does not change after definition. 

```python
agent_team = RoundRobinGroupChat([weather_agent]) 
result = await agent_team.run(
    task="What is the weather in New York?",
    termination_condition=MaxMessageTermination(max_messages=2),
)
```


### What did you expect to happen?

Expected updated UI would look like:

```python
agent_team = RoundRobinGroupChat([weather_agent],   termination_condition=MaxMessageTermination(max_messages=2)
result = await agent_team.run( task="What is the weather in New York?" )
```

Solution would be to update `BaseGroupChat` `init` constructor to take `termination_condition` arg.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

NA

### AutoGen version

0.4

### Which package was this bug in

AgentChat
